_comment: Where the TikTok UI covers a 1080x1920 video. Single source of truth: checks.py, render_overlays.py --show-safe-area, panels.html and render_panels.py all read this. Measured 2026-10-29 from a TikTok feed screenshot on an iPhone (19.5:9): the video is scaled 0.95 to fill the height, 54 px are cropped off each side; 20:9 Android phones crop ~108 px per side. Coordinates are video pixels.

zones.why: cropped off on phones taller than 9:16
cropped off on phones taller than 9:16
status bar, Following / For You / Friends tabs, search
avatar, like, comment, save, share, sound disc
username, caption (2 lines + more), sound marquee

readable._comment: Anything that must be read goes here. Below y=1040 the right edge is 860, not 970. Centred lines (x=540): width <= 846 above y=1040, <= 640 below it (the right column is 320 px from centre).

exempt: full-frame flashes, the vignette, blurred/dimmed footage and anything decorative may cover the zones; the checks look at overlay pixels with alpha > 128 only.
